finding: In a report introduced as another interpretive view, the voice is Mujahid: he takes the command as the prescribed prayer and the sacrifice of camels. The recorded route runs through Ibn Humayd, Hakkam ibn Salm and Harun ibn al-Mughira, Anbasa, and Ibn Abi Najih to Mujahid. This records the route as presented, without an authentication or independence judgment.
